deployments_detail.use: HPE Aruba Networking Central GenAI-based AI Search: LLM-powered natural-language search engine embedded in the AIOps network management platform, letting network operators query documentation and telemetry conversationally. Included across all license tiers, launched FY24 Q2. [Multiple LLMs (undisclosed)]

HPE Aruba Networking Central with agentic mesh + Networking Copilot: network of interconnected AI agents for autonomous, self-driving network operations (provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis). Available starting Q3 2025. [HPE GreenLake Intelligence]

HPE GreenLake Intelligence / GreenLake Copilot: agentic AI framework infused across HPE's hybrid cloud stack (compute, storage, networking, virtualization) for autonomous hybrid-cloud operations, cost/security optimization, and natural-language operator assistance. GreenLake Copilot beta from Q3 2025. [HPE GreenLake Intelligence, NVIDIA]

HPE OpsRamp agentic command center: AI agents embedded in the hybrid observability/AIOps platform for autonomous alert handling, incident processing, and root-cause analysis, including agentic monitoring for AI factories (GPUs, models, storage, networking). [HPE OpsRamp / GreenLake Intelligence]

HPE InfoSight: AIOps platform using machine learning to deliver predictive analytics that predict, prevent and auto-resolve infrastructure problems (storage, servers, VMs) from cross-fleet telemetry gathered from HPE systems worldwide. Long-deployed in production across customer fleets. [HPE InfoSight (proprietary ML)]
GreenLake for AI + Cray/ProLiant AI servers + GreenLake Intelligence agentic AI framework/Copilot

ChatHPE GenAI Hub: HPE's internal, secure generative AI platform/assistant built on HPE Private Cloud AI, enabling employees across teams to safely use GenAI/LLMs for productivity (including an internal HR assistant chatbot). Part of 250+ internal AI use cases HPE runs across finance, operations and marketing. [HPE Private Cloud AI]

SASE Copilot for HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect: AI-driven security copilot providing natural-language insights on network activity and threats, unveiled at Black Hat USA 2025 as part of HPE's AI-driven security innovations. [HPE Aruba Networking]

Alfred / CFO Insights: internal agentic + generative AI platform for HPE's finance organization (~3,600 people). Powers weekly operational performance reviews (replacing ~100 manually-built PowerPoint pages), and automates transactional finance across accounts payable, accounts receivable, credit & collections, payroll, procurement and internal audit. Processes 300M+ financial line items in near real-time; reengineered NVIDIA NIMs for deterministic outputs. Runs on HPE Private Cloud AI with Deloitte's Zora AI platform. [Deloitte (Zora AI), NVIDIA (NIM microservices), HPE Private Cloud AI]
deployments_detail.value: ~40% reduction in financial reporting cycle; at least 25% reduction in processing costs
